newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tada ask-only, weighs on other construction shares.
newsitem.headline: Tada ask-only, weighs on other construction shares.

text.p: Shares in Japanese construction company Tada Corp were ask-only in early Tokyo morning trade on Thursday after news that it has applied for court protection under Japanese bankruptcy laws.
As of 0023 MT, the shares were ask-only at 137 yen, compared with its Wednesday close of 142 yen.
Other construction-sectoral shares 0#CON.T also remained weak on lingering worries over their financial health which were reinforced by Tada's financial failure.

Led by Tokai Kogyo Co Ltd, which applied for court protection from creditors earlier this month, construction firms such as Aoki Corp, Mitsui Construction Co Ltd, Kumagai Gumi Co Ltd, Nakano Corp and Sata Construction Co Ltd nearly dominate the top 10 list of the biggest percentage losers on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
